title: White Eagle
description: An Indian pony-express rider C1 catches post-Civil War horse thieves.

title: The Mountain Men
description: Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.

title: Decision at Sundown
description: A gunman (Randolph Scott) rides into Sundown for a showdown with the big shot (John Carroll) he blames for stealing his wife.

title: The Last Rebel
description: Two Confederates (Joe Namath, Jack Elam) save a man's (Woody Strode) life and cause trouble in 1865 Missouri.

title: The Avenger
description: Mysterious Mexican rider the Black Shadow (Buck Jones) hunts down the outlaws who killed his brother.

title: The Texican
description: A fugitive lawman (Audie Murphy) leaves Mexico to get the Texas saloon boss (Broderick Crawford) who framed him and killed his brother.

title: The Kid From Broken Gun
description: A masked avenger (Charles Starrett) tries to help an innocent man (Jack Mahoney) accused of murder.

title: The Tall T
description: An outlaw (Richard Boone) and his men hold an heiress (Maureen O'Sullivan), her cowardly husband and a rancher (Randolph Scott).

title: The Big Gundown
description: Lawman John Corbett (Lee Van Cleef) searches the U.S.-Mexico border for a Mexican peasant (Tomas Milian) accused of raping and killing a 12-year-old girl.

title: Good Day for a Hanging
description: The new marshal (Fred MacMurray) is the only one in town who thinks a charming killer (Robert Vaughn) should hang.

title: 7th Cavalry
description: Absent from Custer's Last Stand, an Army captain (Randolph Scott) volunteers for the Little Bighorn burial detail.

title: Laramie Mountains
description: The Durango Kid learns that crooked scouts are behind attempts to escalate a war between a local tribe and the cavalry.

title: Last of the Comanches
description: A cavalry sergeant (Broderick Crawford) leads soldiers, civilians and an Indian (Johnny Stewart) on a desert trek.

title: Comanche Station
description: Three outlaws join a loner (Randolph Scott) and another man's wife (Nancy Gates), who was kidnapped by Indians.

title: The Great Sioux Massacre
description: The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).

title: 3:10 to Yuma
description: A rancher (Van Heflin) needing cash is hired to put an outlaw (Glenn Ford) on the train to Yuma prison.

title: Wyoming Renegades
description: An ex-convict (Phil Carey) and his girlfriend (Martha Hyer) cannot start over until they stop Butch Cassidy's (Gene Evans) gang.

title: Blackjack Ketchum, Desperado
description: A gunfighter (Howard Duff) wants peace in the valley, but a cattle baron (Victor Jory) and his brothers want war.

title: The Guns of Fort Petticoat
description: An Army deserter (Audie Murphy) shows defenseless Texas women how to hold off Indians out to avenge a massacre.

title: Go West, Young Girl!
description: New England writer Netty and cavalry widow Gilda team up to find Billy the Kid.
